issues.reason: The tense half stands — "the surface tense decides, mechanically" and the appositive precedent give a past clause's secondary predication the host's wrapper, so the flat present (Member sk_freedom_movement_1 trickle) asserts a standing state the same sentence says was superseded — but the "un-linked to the start event" half does not, since Resultatives & secondary predicates licenses a depictive as a plain concurrent state with no link.

Goal is the motion-path oblique ("into / onto / to" under Motion result), and the oblique rule says to decide by the question the PP answers and to use "the preposition actually used — never a synonym head for a near-fit reading", so (Goal sk_turn_1 sk_gusher_1) asserts a spatial destination for a change-of-kind clause.

Witnesses are anonymous and "don't corefer" by design and the instruction set has no become / change-of-kind operator, so the unrecorded identity is exactly the coverage gap the reviewer files in q2 and no emitted atom is false, ill-typed or over-asserted.

gaps_confirmed: "V as NP" predicative complement ("started as a trickle") — no rule assigns a phase / capacity predicative
change-of-kind / becoming ("turned into a gusher") — no operator identifies the source entity with the result kind
live metaphor — a non-literal kind predication of an abstract referent is asserted literally; the coherence test covers only fixed idioms
new_gaps: coordinated VPs naming successive phases of one entity get no ordering atom: Before / BeforeBy is prescribed only for past perfects and explicit temporal connectives, so the trickle-then-gusher sequence is unrecoverable
repair_summary: Wrapped the "as a trickle" secondary predication in the host clause's tense — (Past (Member sk_freedom_movement_1 trickle)) — so it no longer asserts a present, unbounded state. Replaced the motion-path (Goal sk_turn_1 sk_gusher_1) with the preposition-named oblique (Into sk_turn_1 sk_gusher_1), the preposition actually used.
notes: The change-of-kind identity is still unrecorded after repair; there is no licensed operator for it, so it is filed as a gap rather than filled by an invention.
